detail.am: ክፍያው በቤተሰብዎ ብዛት እና በደረጃው ይለያያል፤ ለድሆች ቤተሰቦች ምትሃት ሊኖር ይችላል።
detail.om: Kaffaltiin lakkoofsa fi sadarkaa warraanaan jijjiirama; hiyyeessotaaf fooyya'a jiraachuu mala.
detail.en: The amount depends on your household tier; subsidies may exist for poor families.

title.om: Kardii insuraa warraanaa fudhaa
title.en: Collect your family insurance card

title.om: Kardiin dhaabbilee fayyaa mootummaatti tajaajila argadhaa
title.en: Use the card at public health facilities

detail.om: Waggaan xumura yommuu ta'u irra deebi'ee fooyyessaa.
detail.en: Renew it again when the year ends.

note.am: በአንዳንድ ቦታ ለድሆች ቤተሰቦች ምትሃት አለ፤ ያረጋግጡ።
note.om: Iddoon tokko tokko hiyyeessotaaf kaffaltii fokkisu jira; mirkaneessaa.
note.en: Some areas subsidize poor households; ask at the office.

estimatedTime.am: በቢሮው ከ30 ደቂቃ እስከ 1 ሰዓት፤ ካርዱ ብዙ ጊዜ በዚያው ቀን ይሰጣል (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Waajjiratti daqiiqaa 30 hanga sa'aatii 1; kardiin baay'een guyyaa sanatti kenna (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: About 30 minutes to 1 hour; the card is often given the same day (confirm)

text.am: የመድን ዓመትዎ ሲያልቅ ከመተካቱ በፊት ያድሱ፤ ጊዜው ያለፈው ካርድ በጤና ጣቢያ አይሠራም
text.om: Waggaan insuraa xumuraa dura fooyyessaa; kardiin dhabe mani fayyaatti hin hojjetu
text.en: Renew before the insurance year ends; an expired card is not accepted at the health center

text.am: አባላትን ሁሉ ሳታካትቱ አትመዝገቡ፤ ያልተመዘገበ አባል ክፍያውን በራሱ ይከፍላል
text.om: Miseensota hundi galmeessaa; kan galmeefame hin taane kaffaltii kaa'a
text.en: List every family member at registration; an unlisted member pays out of pocket

text.om: Kataaalaa kaffaltii olkaa'aa; ragaa isaa ni barbaachisa
text.en: Keep the payment receipt as proof

name.am: የክትባት ካርድ እና የጤና መዝገብ መተካት
name.om: Kaardii kaltuu fi kitaaba fayyaa bakka buusuu
name.en: Vaccination card and health record replacement

shortDescription.am: የጠፋ የክትባት ካርድ ወይም የጤና መዝገብ ይተኩ።
shortDescription.om: Kaardii kaltuu ykn kitaaba fayyaa dhabee bakka buusaa.
shortDescription.en: Replace a lost vaccination card or health record.

text.am: የእናት ወይም የልጅ መታወቂያ ወይም ፋይዳ
text.om: Qindaa'a haadhaa ykn ijollee ykn Faydaa
text.en: Mother's or child's ID, or Fayda
Child's birth certificate

text.om: Kaardii ykn galmee duraan jira yoo ta'e
text.en: Any old card or record, if you have it

title.am: ወደ ልጁ ክትባት የተሰጠበት የጤና ጣቢያ ወይም የጤና ጋሪ ይሂዱ
title.om: Gara mani fayyaa kaltuun ijolleef kenname ykn gara tibbe fayyaa deemaa
title.en: Go to the health center or health post where the child was vaccinated

detail.am: መዝገቡ ብዙ ጊዜ በዚያው ጣቢያ ይቀመጣል።
detail.en: The record is usually kept there.

title.am: መታወቂያዎን ያሳዩ እና የልጁን ስም እና የትውልድ ቀን ይንገሩ
title.om: Qindaa'a kee agarsiisaa maqaa fi guyyaa dhalachaa ijolleetiin himaa
title.en: Show your ID and give the child's name and birth date

title.om: Galmee irraa kaardii kaltuu akka bakka bu'u gaafadhaa
title.en: Ask them to issue a replacement card from the record

detail.am: እስካሁን የተሰጡትን ክትባቶች ሁሉ በካርዱ ላይ እንዲጻፉ ያድርጉ።
detail.om: Kaltuwwan hanga ammaa kennaman hunda kaardiitti akka galmeeffaman godhaa.
detail.en: Make sure all doses already given are written on the card.

title.om: Kaardii yeroon hundatti olkaa'aa
title.en: Take the card to every vaccination visit

detail.am: ቀሪዎቹን ክትባቶች በተሰጠው መርሃ ግብር ይቀጥሉ።
detail.om: Kaltuu hafan akka saffisaatti itti fufaa.
detail.en: Continue the remaining doses on schedule.

estimatedTime.am: ብዙ ጊዜ ከ30 ደቂቃ እስከ 1 ሰዓት (ያረጋግጡ)

text.am: በመጀመሪያ ልጁ ክትባት የተሰጠበት ጣቢያ ይሂዱ፤ መዝገቡ እዚያው ነው
text.om: Duraan gara iddoo kaltuun kenname deemaa; galmee sana irra jira
text.en: Go back to the original vaccination site first; the record is there

text.am: አዲሱን ካርድ በጥንቃቄ ያስቀምጡ፤ ማጣቱ ክትባት ሊደገም ያደርጋል
text.om: Kaardii haaraa haqaa olkaa'aa; dhabuun kaltuu irra deebi'a
text.en: Keep the new card safe; losing it again may mean repeated doses

text.am: ቀሪ የክትባት ቀናትን አትርሱ፤ ልጁ በጊዜው ይጠበቃል
text.om: Guyyaa kaltuu hafan hin dhihaatin; ijolleen yeroon kan ittisa
text.en: Don't miss the remaining vaccination dates; your child stays protected on time

shortDescription.am: ለሥራ፣ ለመንጃ ወይም ለጉዞ የጤና ማረጋገጫ።
shortDescription.om: Ragaa fayyaa hojii, konkolaachisaa ykn imalaa.
shortDescription.en: Medical certificate for work, driving or travel.

text.en: Your ID
Photo (sometimes requested)

text.am: ከሠራተኛ ቤትዎ ወይም ከተቋሙ ካገኙት የማመልከቻ ወረቀት
text.om: Iyyannoo hojjettootaa ykn dhaabbataa irraa yoo argattan
text.en: A request letter from your employer or institution, if they give one

title.am: ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ወይም ክሊኒክ ይሂዱ እና ወረቀቱ ለምን እንደሚያስፈልግ ይንገሩ
title.om: Gara mani fayyaa ykn kliiniikii deemaa; ragichi maaf barbaachise himaa
title.en: Go to a health center or clinic and say what the certificate is for

detail.am: ለሥራ፣ ለመንጃ ወይም ለጉዞ የተለያዩ ምርመራዎች ሊጠየቁ ይችላሉ።
detail.om: Hojii, konkolaachisaa ykn imalaaf ramaddii adda adda gaafatamuu mala.
detail.en: Work, driving and travel often need different checks.

title.om: Ogeessi fayyaa si ramada
title.en: The nurse or doctor examines you

detail.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ቀላል የላብ ምርመራ ሊያስፈልግ ይችላል።
detail.om: Yeroo tokko tokko ramaddii laabii barbaachisa.
detail.en: Simple lab tests may be needed.

title.om: Kaffaltii ramaddii kaffalaa
title.en: Pay the examination fee

title.om: Ragaa mallatteessame fi teeme fudhaa
title.en: Collect the signed and stamped certificate

estimatedTime.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በዚያው ቀን ይሰራል፤ የላብ ምርመራ ካስፈልገ ወደ ኋላ ይቀረባል (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Baay'een guyyaa sanatti kennama; ramaddii laabii yoo barbaachise heddumina (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: Often the same day; longer if lab tests are needed (confirm)

text.am: በመጀመሪያ ወረቀቱ ለምን እንደሚያስፈልግ ይንገሩ፤ የተለያዩ ዓላማዎች የተለያዩ ምርመራ ይጠይቃሉ
text.om: Durutti ragichi maaf barbaachise himaa; kaayyoon adda adda ramaddii adda adda gaafata
text.en: Say what the certificate is for; different purposes need different checks

text.om: Ragaa mallatteessaa fi teeme malee hin fudhatamu
text.en: A certificate without signature and stamp will be rejected

text.am: ወረቀቱ ብዙ ጊዜ ለወሰነ ጊዜ ብቻ የሚሠራ ነው፤ የተቋሙን ሁኔታ ያረጋግጡ
text.om: Ragichi baay'een yeroon murtaa'e qofaaf ni hojjeta; haala dhaabbataa mirkaneessaa
text.en: Certificates often have limited validity; check what your institution requires
The old (expiring) license
Owner's ID

text.am: ማስረጃ ቦታው ላይ (የይዞታ ወይም የኪራይ ውል)
text.en: Premises documents (ownership or lease)
Inspection slip

title.am: ፈቃድዎ ከመውደቁ በፊት ወደ ከተማ አስተዳደሩ የጤና ቢሮ ይሂዱ
title.om: Hayyaman kee dhaawwachuun dura gara waajjira fayyaa magaalaan deemaa
title.en: Go to the city administration health office before your license expires

title.am: የቀድሞውን ፈቃድ እና ሌሎች ወረቀቶች ያቅርቡ
title.om: Hayyama duraatii fi docsii dabalataa dhiyeessaa
title.en: Submit the old license and other documents

title.om: Iddoon sakatta'iif ni ba'ama
title.en: Inspectors will visit the premises

detail.am: ችግር ካስተውሉ ያስተካክሉት እና እንደገና እንዲመለከቱ ያድርጉ።
detail.om: Rakko yoo mul'ise fooyyessaa irra deebi'inee akka ilaalan godhaa.
detail.en: If they find problems, fix them and ask for another check.

title.am: የእድሳት ክፍያውን ይክፈሉ እና ደረሰኙን ይውሰዱ
title.om: Kaffaltii fooyyessuu kaffalaa kataaalaa fudhaa
title.en: Pay the renewal fee and keep the receipt

title.om: Hayyama haaraa fudhaa
title.en: Collect the renewed license

estimatedTime.am: ብዙ ጊዜ ፍተሻን ጨምሮ ከ1 ቀን እስከ 1 ሳምንት፤ ያረጋግጡ
estimatedTime.om: Baay'een sakatta'umsa dabalatee guyyaa 1 hanga torbanii 1; mirkaneessaa
estimatedTime.en: Usually 1 day to 1 week including the inspection (confirm)

text.am: ፈቃዱ ከመውደቁ በፊት ያድሱ፤ ያለፈቃድ ሥራ ቅጣት ያመጣል
text.om: Hayyaman dhaawwachuu isaa dura fooyyessaa; hayyama malee hojjachuun adabbii fidata
text.en: Renew before it expires; operating without a license can bring penalties

text.am: ፍተሻው ይመጣ በፊት ቦታውን ያጽዱ፤ ችግር እድሳቱን ያዘግያል
text.om: Sakatta'umsi dhufuu dura iddoo qulqullessaa; rakkoon fooyyessuu heddummeessa
text.en: Prepare the premises before inspection; problems delay the renewal

text.am: ደረሰኙን እና የፈቃድ ኮፒ በሥራ ቦታዎ ያስቀምጡ
text.om: Kataaalaa fi koppii hayyama iddoo hojii kee olkaa'aa
text.en: Keep the receipt and a copy of the license on site
